item.title: Can GLP-1 Drugs Help With Managing Multiple Sclerosis?
item.description: GLP-1 drugs are not approved for multiple sclerosis (MS) treatment, but early research suggests that they may affect inflammation and nerve health in ways that could benefit people with MS.

item.title: How Does a Vasectomy Work, and Is Getting One the Right Choice for You?
item.description: Vasectomy is a permanent birth control option for men. Learn what it is, how the procedure works, and who benefits from it.

item.title: How to Improve Your Sleep When Living With Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI)
item.description: Improve sleep in people with MCI: Discover the impact of sleep disorders on memory and cognition, and explore effective strategies like exercise, light therapy, and cognitive behavioral therapy to enhance sleep quality.

item.title: What to Ask Your Doctor if Your Bipolar Medication Isn’t Working
item.description: If your bipolar meds aren't effective, talk to your doctor about symptoms, side effects, and potential adjustments. Discover essential questions to improve your treatment plan.

item.title: Can You Get Measles if You’re Vaccinated?
item.description: Measles outbreaks are taking place around the U.S. How likely is it to get measles if you’re vaccinated?

item.title: How Much Fiber Do I Need? Use Our Fiber Calculator
item.description: Use this calculator to find out how much fiber you need. Plus, learn about the top sources of fiber, how to increase fiber gradually, and how to track fiber intake.

item.title: Atopic Dermatitis Treatments: Drug and Nondrug Therapies
item.description: Read about medications, light therapy, and home treatments that can help relieve dry, itchy skin caused by atopic dermatitis (eczema).

item.title: Is It Healthy to Sleep With Socks On?
item.description: Learn what research tells us about how wearing socks to bed affects sleep and foot hygiene, plus beliefs about socks, sex, and hot flashes.

item.title: Maintaining Your Normal With MBC: How to Preserve Energy and Daily Independence
item.description: Learn how to manage fatigue and maintain independence when you have metastatic breast cancer (MBC), with strategies like simplifying tasks, setting boundaries, and prioritizing joy.

item.title: How to Overcome Fear and Prepare for a Cancer Clinical Trial
item.description: Learn about the benefits of participating in a cancer clinical trial and how to navigate concerns about the unknown.
